name: GDrive Backup
description: Save & load your data to Google Drive!

slot-count.name: Save slots count
slot-count.description: Choose how many save slots are available. <cr>Note:</c> This setting is purely <cg>visual</c>, changing this value does <cy>not</c> delete your save files.

button-position.name: Button position
button-position.description: Sets the <cy>position</c> of the mod's button on the <cg>account menu</c>.

bottom-button.name: Main menu shortcut button
bottom-button.description: <cg>adds</cg> a button for GDrive Backup to the bottom of the main menu (next to the geode button).

new-icon.name: Use new Drive icon
new-icon.description: Use the new weird gradient-y google drive icon for the buttons instead of the 'lame' 'old' 'one'

load-game-options.name: Load game & editor options
load-game-options.description: Enable loading your saved game & editor options (e.g. quick keys, CBS, button rows, link controls, etc.). <cy>This doesn't restore every single option, and mainly excludes graphics options.</c>
